parameters: It seems you've just about cleaned this up.
Yes, your excellency. The army of Antares is broken.
Then it should be a trivial matter to finish the job, yes? The people in the capital are anxious - they crave a swift resolution.
Prime Minister, they've dug themselves in deep. If we are reckless in this attack, we risk unnecessary casualties.
\n[8], was it? You've made a bit of a name for yourself, you know.\! Some in the Army ranks speak of a teal-haired youth who shocked Antares with a dramatic move and put his rebellion to a quick end.
Commander Trihan, does \n[5] speak for you as well? Must I summon a bit more patience to spare our men?
Their defenses do appear to be formidable, your excellency. A more cautious approach would indeed save lives.
As you wish. Just one thing... do make sure that \n[8] makes it through this battle intact... I see great promise in \n[1]. Commander Trihan, the field is yours.
Your army has been vital to our operation so far. We're going to need shock troops to break inside their stronghold. We'll be right there with you.
....\| Yes, I think we can do it.
We've backed them into a corner. They've got nothing to lose and every reason to fight to the death...
